theory.intro: The **perimeter** is the distance all the way around the outside of a 2D shape. Add the lengths of all the sides.
facts: Perimeter $=$ the sum of **all** side lengths.
steps: List every side length around the shape.
Write the answer with the correct unit.

foundation.solution_text:
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
$P=12+5+12+5$
$=34\text{ cm}$

The dashes show the two slanted sides are equal, so both are $6\text{ cm}$.
$P=6+6+4$
$=16\text{ cm}$

development.solution_text:
Opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal.
$P=2\times(14+9)$
$=2\times23$
$=46\text{ m}$
